ar.title: دجاج محشو بالأحشاء، مسلوق ثم مقلي
ar.intro: طبق دجاج محشو بالأحشاء، نسخة مقلية من كبة الدجاج.

steps.n1: قطّع بصلتان ناعماً جداً وقطّع الحوصلة والقلب إلى قطع صغيرة جداً. امزجها مع التوابل والملح والفلفل.
steps.n3: ضع ماء كافياً لتغطية الدجاج حتى النصف في قدر واغلِه مع البصل الباقي والملح، أضف الدجاج واطهِ لمدة حوالي 20 دقيقة، ثم أخرجه.
steps.n4: سخّن الزيت في قدر آخر، امزج المسطكة لمدة 10 ثوان، أضف الدجاج، غطِّه بإحكام وأبعده عن النار لمدة 1–2 دقيقة.
steps.n5: اقلِ الدجاج مع تقليبه حتى يصبح بني اللون من جميع الجوانب.

en.title: Giblet-Stuffed Chicken, Boiled then Fried (Firakh Mahshiya wi Mihammara)
en.intro: Recipe 117, page 54 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

steps.n1: Finely chop two onions and cut the gizzards and hearts into very small pieces. Mix them with the spice, salt and pepper.
steps.n2: Stuff the chickens with the mixture and sew them up.
steps.n3: Bring enough water to half-cover the chickens to the boil with the remaining onion and salt, add the chickens and cook for about 20 minutes, then lift them out.
steps.n4: Heat oil in another pot, stir in the mastic for 10 seconds, add the chickens, cover tightly and turn off the heat for 1–2 minutes.
steps.n5: Fry the chickens, turning them until browned all over.

legacySteps: Finely chop two onions and cut the gizzards and hearts into very small pieces. Mix them with the spice, salt and pepper.
Stuff the chickens with the mixture and sew them up.
Bring enough water to half-cover the chickens to the boil with the remaining onion and salt, add the chickens and cook for about 20 minutes, then lift them out.
Heat oil in another pot, stir in the mastic for 10 seconds, add the chickens, cover tightly and turn off the heat for 1–2 minutes.
Fry the chickens, turning them until browned all over.
